== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34646) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Sersen DS AOBS.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 26 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 26 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>378747adebe72ad1b89643e70f9bd6f76881b989eaa29e02e32467b1fd3b23b8</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Cad Bane (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>203_24^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Coruscant (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>203_31^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>106_13*, 109_11*, 10_29*, 10_45*, 112_16*, 12_114*, 13_51*, 13_52*, 13_54*, 13_66*, 13_72*, 13_78*, 13_81*, 13_84*, 13_86*, 13_90*, 13_95*, 13_98*, 1_308*, 200_100*, 200_110*, 200_95*, 200_99*, 201_25*, 201_38*, 203_32*, 203_34*, 205_14*, 206_12*, 209_43*, 209_51*, 213_13*, 216_5*, 219_19*, 220_2*, 221_19*, 223_26*, 223_29*, 223_7*, 226_7*, 7_278*, 7_312*, 9_139*</nowiki>.
